cour.name: La cour des sciences
cour.alt: The science-faculty forecourt, in ink and gouache: a white telescope on a black tripod and a round stone plinth stands on the gravel. Open glass doors show the rock hall's cream floor, tan walls and a purple crystal in the left bay. A wooden door and an open arcade are on the west wing, a wooden door is on the east wing, and a low stone wall has an open gate toward the campus path. Autumn trees stand behind the tan building.

doors.label: Le hall
doors.hint: Through the open glass doors into the rock hall

sciences.name: Le hall des roches
sciences.alt: The ground-floor hall of the science faculty, in ink and gouache, looking toward open glass doors. A rock mound with one tunnel, a lantern and an ore cart sits on a low table. A torn sack of earth spills from a wooden cart, with a seedling in the tear. One low gray stone slab lies on the open floor. A geologist holds a sparkling mineral cluster under a lamp that throws a rainbow. A tall purple crystal stands on the right with a mouse at its base. A rubber boot rests in a tray of soil, the sole toward the viewer, and a worm lifts its head. Through the open doors are a gravel path, autumn trees and the campus telescope.

doors.label: La cour
doors.hint: Through the glass doors to the telescope in the court
